root_cause.mechanism: Rank 0 called _max_time(), which performs comm.allreduce(), inside rank-zero-only evidence construction. Non-root ranks skipped that block and entered the final comm.Barrier(). The MPI collectives therefore had incompatible ordering after the memory gather.
root_cause.gather_payload: process_memory_snapshot() dictionary; approximately 90 bytes pickled per rank in the diagnostic measurement
root_cause.rank_divergence_path: PROVEN by source control flow; the live run did not provide per-rank markers, so the exact rank instruction pointer is not reconstructed.

patch_contract.storage: one append-and-flush JSONL file per rank derived from the requested telemetry path
patch_contract.global_readiness: PC_READY and PC_READY_GLOBAL are emitted only after every rank has reported the frozen AIJ/CG/GAMG route.
patch_contract.collective_guardrails: Local failures are allgathered before the next collective; rank-zero evidence and raw-report write failures are likewise synchronized.

verification.mpi_failure_smoke: 2-rank readiness failure propagated to both ranks and finalized cleanly
